channel.title: Wellby blog
channel.description: Practical guides for referral-driven care teams: tracking referrals, managing referral sources, and measuring what outreach wins.

item.title: Referral Tracking: What to Log When a Referral Comes In
item.description: Simple referral tracking for care teams: the seven details to log on every referral, and how to keep the record honest week after week.

item.title: How to find every referral source in your territory
item.description: Why stale referral lists cost you, where public information about hospitals, physicians and facilities lives, and how to keep your territory list honest.

item.title: What to say to referral partners: thank-you, check-in and update templates
item.description: Short templates for thanking referral sources, checking in with quiet partners and sharing updates, plus tips on keeping them personal and HIPAA-aware.

item.title: Referral share: the one number post-acute marketers should track
item.description: Visit counts tell you how busy your team is. Referral share tells you whether it is working. What it means and why it changes how you plan outreach.

item.title: How to spot a referral partner going quiet before you lose them
item.description: Partners rarely announce that they have switched agencies. Why drops are easy to miss, what to check first, and how to run a win-back that works.

item.title: A weekly plan for home health and hospice marketers
item.description: A simple, repeatable week for community liaisons and business development reps: where to spend time, how to prioritize visits, and what to log.
